story_zh: 1763年建成的伊犁将军府驻地，清代治理新疆的军政中枢，'伊犁九城'的核心。1871年毁于战火，旧城垣今天仍伫立在伊犁河边。
story_en: Built in 1763 as the seat of the General of Ili — the military and administrative heart of Qing Xinjiang. Destroyed in 1871; its rammed-earth walls still stand by the Ili River.

story_zh: 1882年清政府收复伊犁后，在旧城北面另建的新城，延续'惠远'之名，沿用至清末。
story_en: After Qing forces recovered Ili in 1882, a new city was built north of the ruined old one, carrying the name Huiyuan into the last decades of the dynasty.

story_zh: 1766年建，满营驻防城，与惠远互为犄角，拱卫将军府所在的军政核心。
story_en: Built in 1766 as a Manchu banner garrison town, forming a defensive pair with Huiyuan around the General's headquarters.

story_zh: 1762年建，绿营兵驻防之城，承担屯垦与守备双重职责。'绥定'二字，寄托着安定边疆的期望。
story_en: Built in 1762, garrisoned by Green Standard troops who farmed the land and guarded the frontier. Its name carries the hope of a pacified borderland.

story_zh: 1766年建，地处九城西北，与绥定、广仁共同构成河谷西北的驻防链。
story_en: Built in 1766, anchoring the northwestern chain of garrison towns together with Suiding and Guangren.

story_zh: 1766年建，位于伊犁河西段，是九城西部防线的一环。
story_en: Built in 1766 on the western reach of the Ili River, one link in the nine-town western line.

story_zh: 1766年建，九城最西端之一，直面霍尔果斯方向的要道。'拱宸'意为拱卫京师。
story_en: Built in 1766 at the western end of the line, facing the Khorgos approach. Its name means 'guarding the throne'.

story_zh: 1766年建，九城中最靠东南的一座，承担着河谷东段的驻防与屯田。
story_en: Built in 1766, the southeasternmost of the nine towns, garrisoning and farming the eastern valley.

story_zh: 1762年建，扼守伊犁河谷北面的塔勒奇山口，是从北面进入河谷的门户。
story_en: Built in 1762 to command the Taleqi Pass, the northern gateway into the Ili valley.

story_zh: 九城之首，1762年建于固勒扎，最初是回部屯田与商贸的中心。今天的伊宁市，就生长在这座城的旧址之上。
story_en: First of the nine garrison towns (1762), built at Ghulja as a center of agriculture and trade. Modern Yining city grew directly over its foundations.

story_zh: 早于清代的古城遗址，提示这片土地上的聚落史远早于西迁故事的开始。
story_en: A pre-Qing ruin — a reminder that settlement in this valley began long before the westward migration.

story_zh: 位于伊犁河谷以南天山方向的要隘之城，守护通往南疆的山口通道。
story_en: A garrison town guarding the Tianshan passes south of the Ili valley, on the approach toward southern Xinjiang.

story_zh: 索伦营驻防之地。与锡伯、察哈尔、厄鲁特等营一样，索伦部众奉调西迁，成为伊犁驻防体系的重要一翼。
story_en: Garrison of the Solon battalion — like the Xibe, Chahar and Oirat battalions, they were ordered west to form one wing of the Ili garrison system.

story_zh: 锡伯营八牛录之一。1766年，西迁的锡伯军民被编为八旗八牛录，在伊犁河南岸屯垦戍边，每个牛录筑城而居，今天的察布查尔锡伯自治县即由此而来。
story_en: One of the eight niru (banner companies) of the Xibe battalion. After the 1764–66 migration, Xibe soldiers and families were organized into eight companies along the Ili River, each building its own walled town — the origin of today's Qapqal Xibe Autonomous County.

story_zh: 卡伦，清代边疆的警戒哨所。锡伯营官兵轮班驻守于此，巡查边境、传递军情、看护牧群。一间屋、一座瞭望台、一群轮换的戍卒，就是帝国边疆的神经末梢。
story_en: A karun — a Qing frontier watch post. Xibe soldiers rotated through these small forts to patrol the border, relay military dispatches, and watch over herds. One building, one lookout, a handful of rotating guards: the nerve endings of an empire.

story_zh: 拱卫主城的外围营盘，驻军与物资的集结点。
story_en: An outlying barracks anchoring the main garrison towns — a staging point for troops and supplies.
